description: DailyDashboard component that consumes useMacroGoal + useDailyFoodLogs and the pure summarizeDailyMacros to render cozy remaining-calories + per-macro progress bars with loading/error/empty/no-goal states, plus App wiring so an authenticated user can reach the dashboard and ManualFoodForm. Over-budget: clamp the bar at 100% but show the real (possibly negative) remaining number in a warning accent. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002. Keep the Expo root untouched.
steps: Create a small presentational apps/macros-web/src/features/food-logs/components/MacroProgressBar.tsx (or inline sub-component): props { label, consumed, remaining, percent, unit }. Render label + a track (bg-sage/20 or bg-cardBorder) with a filled bar width = `${percent}%` using bg-sage; when remaining < 0 (over budget) style the remaining number in the pink/warning accent (text-pink or a warning class) and keep the bar at 100%. Use Tailwind token NAMES only (no raw hex). Keep it tiny and pure.

Create apps/macros-web/src/features/food-logs/DailyDashboard.tsx: props { userId: string }. Compute today's date as an ISO yyyy-mm-dd string (local date; document the helper). Call useMacroGoal(userId) and useDailyFoodLogs(userId, date). Handle states in order: if either query isLoading -> cozy loading copy (COPY.dashboard.loading inside FormCard); if either isError -> friendly error copy (never raw error); if goal is null/undefined -> COPY.dashboard.noGoal friendly CTA (do NOT crash or show NaN); else compute summary = summarizeDailyMacros(logs ?? [], goal) and render remaining calories prominently plus MacroProgressBar for protein/fat/carbs. If logs are empty but a goal exists, show the full-goal remaining and an empty-logs hint (COPY.dashboard.empty). Use FormCard + cozy tokens (bg-cream background handled by App; card uses bg-card/rounded-card, font-serif heading, text-ink/text-muted). No useEffect; no console; < 400 lines.

Wire into apps/macros-web/src/App.tsx: add a new authenticated view (e.g. extend the View union with 'diario' / 'dashboard' and add a nav button, OR surface the dashboard + form within the authenticated session area alongside SessionPanel). Render DailyDashboard and ManualFoodForm only when there is a userId (behind the authenticated session, like SessionPanel returns null when unauthenticated). Pass the real userId from useSession(). Reuse the existing cream layout; add any new nav label as a frozen Spanish string. Do not break the existing macros/auth views or their tests (update App.test.tsx expectations if the nav changes). Keep the Expo root app untouched.

Add tests apps/macros-web/src/features/food-logs/__tests__/DailyDashboard.test.tsx: mock useMacroGoal and useDailyFoodLogs. Cases: both loading -> loading copy; one isError -> error copy (no raw error leaked); goal null -> noGoal CTA (no NaN in output); goal + empty logs -> remaining equals targets and empty hint; goal + logs under budget -> correct remaining numbers and bar widths; goal + logs over budget -> negative remaining shown with the warning accent and bar clamped (assert the bar style/width is 100% while the remaining text is negative). Render with a QueryClientProvider only if needed (hooks are mocked). Self-contained (no @energy).
If App.tsx nav/markup changed, update src/App.test.tsx so the existing 3 App tests still pass.
acceptance_criteria: DailyDashboard consumes useMacroGoal + useDailyFoodLogs and summarizeDailyMacros, and renders remaining calories + per-macro progress bars using Tailwind token names only.
Loading, error, empty-logs, and no-active-goal states all render friendly Spanish copy with no crash and no NaN.
Over-budget renders a negative remaining number in a warning accent while the progress bar stays clamped at 100% (asserted in tests).
An authenticated user can reach the dashboard and ManualFoodForm via App.tsx; unauthenticated users do not see them; the Expo root app is untouched.

Full suite green: with energy domain temporarily materialized, npx vitest run passes (including all pre-existing suites and the new food-logs suites); npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass with zero any and no console. The energy domain is removed before finishing so it is not committed.
verification: cd apps/macros-web && (energy materialized) npx vitest run && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
Confirm git status shows NO src/features/energy/ files staged/untracked-to-commit before handing back (energy removed).
Confirm no changes outside apps/macros-web except the .tasks/.agents plan docs (Expo root untouched).
findings: Implemented the daily macro-discounting dashboard and wired it into App.tsx. components/MacroProgressBar.tsx: tiny pure presentational bar, props {label,consumed,remaining,percent,unit}; track is bg-sage/20, fill is bg-sage at style width `${percent}%` (percent is pre-clamped by summarizeDailyMacros so the bar never exceeds 100% even over budget); when remaining<0 the remaining number renders in the pink warning accent (text-pink) while the bar stays clamped; exposes role=progressbar with aria-valuenow for testability; token names only (no raw hex). DailyDashboard.tsx: props {userId}; localToday() helper builds yyyy-mm-dd from LOCAL date parts (NOT toISOString/UTC, documented) to avoid day-shift; calls useMacroGoal(userId) + useDailyFoodLogs(userId,date); state order = (a) either isLoading -> COPY.dashboard.loading in FormCard, (b) either isError -> COPY.dashboard.error in a role=alert (never raw error), (c) goal null -> COPY.dashboard.noGoal CTA (no NaN), (d) else summarizeDailyMacros(logs??[],goal) and render remaining calories prominently (pink + COPY.dashboard.overBudget when negative) plus a MacroProgressBar per protein/fat/carbs; empty logs show COPY.dashboard.empty hint with full remaining; NO useEffect, NO console, <400 lines, shared DashboardHeading sub-component. App.tsx: extended View union with 'diario', added frozen Spanish nav label DIARIO_LABEL='Diario'; renderDiario() shows <DailyDashboard/>+<ManualFoodForm/> only when userId present (SessionPanel-style guard), else a frozen signed-out prompt; existing macros/auth views untouched. Tests: __tests__/DailyDashboard.test.tsx mocks useMacroGoal + useDailyFoodLogs (vi.mock), 6 cases: both loading->loading copy; one isError->error copy with no leaked raw error; goal null->noGoal CTA asserting no 'NaN' in output; goal+empty->remaining equals targets + empty hint; goal+under budget->exact remaining numbers; goal+over budget->negative remaining in text-pink AND progressbar fill width='100%'/aria-valuenow=100 (bar clamped). A remainingTextFor() helper scopes per-bar assertions to avoid the shared 'g' suffix colliding with the consumed span. Self-contained (no @energy). App.test.tsx unchanged and still green (the added nav button did not alter the existing 3 expectations; @energy import preserved). Coverage: food-logs 100% stmts/funcs/lines, 93.4% branch; DailyDashboard 100%/94.7% branch; MacroProgressBar 100%. git status confirmed NO src/features/energy files staged/untracked-to-commit before committing. review_iteration_1_findings: Addressed the v1 review (2026-10-05-051626-review.md). ISSUE #1 (BLOCKING, timezone mismatch) FIXED: extracted the date logic into a shared pure module apps/macros-web/src/features/food-logs/today.ts exporting localToday(now = new Date()): string -> yyyy-mm-dd from LOCAL date parts (not toISOString/UTC), with an injectable `now` for deterministic tests and full JSDoc explaining why read and write must agree. DailyDashboard.tsx now imports localToday from today.ts (removed its private copy) for the query date. ManualFoodForm.tsx now stamps logged_on: localToday() in the AddFoodLogInput it passes to mutate, so the inserted row's logged_on equals exactly the date the dashboard queries; the existing useAddFoodLog invalidation (keyed on saved.logged_on) therefore matches the subscribed key and the just-added item appears in real time even for off-UTC users. AddFoodLogInput already permits logged_on (food_logs Insert has logged_on?), and addFoodLog's `...input` spread already lets a caller-provided logged_on pass through unchanged (no forced default clobber), so the data layer needed no change. Added tests: today.test.ts (4 cases: local-part formatting, zero-padding, no late-night UTC day-shift, default-arg path) and a new ManualFoodForm case asserting the mutate payload's logged_on === localToday() and matches /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/, plus the existing payload-equality test updated to include logged_on. ISSUE #2 (untested App.tsx diary wiring) FIXED: App.test.tsx now renders App with a session-returning mock client (makeMockClient(initialSession)) and mocks ./lib/supabaseClient + macroGoals.data + foodLogs.data so the TanStack hooks resolve deterministically. Two new cases: (a) signed-in -> select the 'Diario' nav -> asserts the DailyDashboard heading (COPY.dashboard.title) AND ManualFoodForm heading (COPY.form.title) render and the signed-out prompt is absent; (b) signed-out -> select 'Diario' -> asserts the DIARIO_SIGNED_OUT prompt shows and neither heading renders. The original 3 App tests are preserved verbatim, including the deliberate `@energy` import and calculateTdee assertion. ISSUE #3 (unit default 'serving' vs DB 'g') INTENTIONAL, no change: this is the documented decision; the manual form captures per-serving totals so quantity=1/unit='serving' is the correct domain default, and addFoodLog is the only insert path, so the data-layer default is the single source of truth. Any future direct insert bypassing addFoodLog would get the DB 'g' default, which is noted. VERIFICATION (energy domain temporarily materialized then removed): npx vitest run = 204/204 across 36 files (was 197; +7 new: 4 today + 1 ManualFoodForm + 2 App); npm run typecheck clean (zero any); npm run lint clean (no-console); npm run build (tsc && vite build) succeeds. Removed src/features/energy and confirmed `git status` shows NO energy files before committing. No useEffect for fetching, reused FormCard/TextField/PrimaryButton, immutable, non-leaky errors, zod validation preserved; Expo root untouched.
